plugins.name: cc-enslaver
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.21.1 hotfixes a pre-existing windows-latest CI red: Stop layer (g)'s file-claim path regex (_PATH_TOKEN) excluded '~', so it silently no-op'd on the GitHub Windows runner whose TEMP is a DOS 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...); the char class now includes '~', with a 4-test deterministic regression. v0.21 inverts the i18n architecture to English-skeleton: English rules/ + prompts/ live at the root and are the source of truth and default injection, Chinese is a first-class translation under rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/ (CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), any language code falls back to the English skeleton, and drift is CI-blocked by i18n_check.py + test_i18n_sync.py (on drift, English wins).
